rows.en: Indeed, women hold only 14 per cent of positions on European corporate boards.
rows.cn: 事实上，女性仅占欧洲企业董事会职位的 14%。

rows.en: A one-hour flight is now billed as a two-hour flight.
rows.cn: 一小时的航程现在被号称为两小时。

rows.uncommon: v. （笑话、观点）奏效，被接受；获得
rows.en: Jokes that work on one person won't necessarily land with another.
rows.cn: 对一个有效的笑话，对另一个人不一定管用。

rows.en: It was only after "toddler" became a common shoppers' term that it evolved into a broadly accepted developmental stage.
rows.cn: 直到“蹒跚学步儿童”变成一个常见购物者用语之后，这一“第三跳板”才演变为人们普遍认可的儿童发展阶段。

rows.uncommon: v. 应对，处理（问题、提问）
rows.en: Now he's living in a council flat and fielding offers from literary agents.
rows.cn: 现在他住在救济公寓中处理来自文稿代理商的约稿。

rows.en: Competition law appears to be the only way to address these imbalances of power.
rows.cn: 竞争法似乎是解决这些权力失衡问题的唯一办法。

rows.uncommon: v. 开始实行，设立（institute rules）
rows.en: Many employers have instituted weight loss and fitness initiatives.
rows.cn: 许多雇主已经实施了减肥和健身计划。

rows.en: You might feel your heart racing or your face turning red, but do whatever you can to remain neutral in both your words and actions.
rows.cn: 你可能感到心跳加速或者面红耳赤，但要尽你所能无论是在言语上还是在动作上都保持不动声色。

rows.uncommon: v. 不予考虑；把……视为（不值一提）
rows.en: It's easy to dismiss as absurd the federal government's ideas for plugging the chronic funding gap of our national parks.
rows.cn: 联邦政府填补国家公园长期存在的资金缺口的想法很容易被视为荒唐可笑而不予考虑。

rows.common: n. 露营；帐篷\nvi. 露营
rows.en: A "southern" camp headed by France wants something different: "European economic government" within an inner core of euro-zone members.
rows.cn: 法国统领的“南部”阵营则另有所求：在欧元区成员国的内部核心成立一个“欧洲经济政府”。

rows.uncommon: v. 以……为例（Take sth 拿…来说）
rows.en: Take the toddler.
rows.cn: 以学步的儿童为例。

rows.uncommon: v. 把……看作，视为（see sth as）
rows.en: We can choose to see failure as “the end of the world."
rows.cn: 我们可以把失败看作“世界末日”。

rows.en: There was a big jump in the number of people who report voluntarily working part-time.
rows.cn: 申报自愿从事兼职工作的人数出现大幅激增。

rows.uncommon: a. 平平的，普通的；平庸的
rows.en: Being average just won't earn you what it used to.
rows.cn: 表现平平完全无法再让你过上普通生活了。

rows.en: …es to mastering the art of deep work - be it lengthy retreats dedicated to a specific task; developing a daily ritual; or taking a "…
rows.cn: 掌握深度工作艺术的方法有很多——或是长久隐退、专注于某一特定工作；或是形成一种日常惯例；或是采取“新闻工作者”的方法，抓住一天中能抓住的深度工作时刻。

rows.en: Not to mention, if the process you're scrapping is one someone else suggested, there's the possibility of hurt feelings.
rows.cn: 更不用说，如果你要摒弃的流程是别人提出的，那还可能会伤害他们的感情。

rows.uncommon: v. 声称，断言（未必属实）
rows.en: You may proudly claim to only have frozen peas in the freezer - that's not good enough.
rows.cn: 你也许会自豪地表示冰箱里只有冷冻青豆——这还不够好。

rows.en: Although technology might change the way we react, it hasn't changed our nature.
rows.cn: 尽管科技可能改变我们的反应方式，但它还没有改变我们的天性。

rows.en: By cutting out the middlemen, the farmers secure more profit for their produce.
rows.cn: 通过绕开中间商，农民为他们的农产品争取到更多的利润。

rows.common: n. 接近；入门\nvt. 接近
rows.en: Some applaud the approach; others are concerned.
rows.cn: 一些对此表示赞同，另一些则表示担忧。

rows.common: vt. 买；获得\nvi. 买\nn. 购买
rows.uncommon: v. 相信，接受（buy into 认同）
rows.en: As a linguist once said, "You can get people to think it's nonsense at the same time that you buy into it."
rows.cn: 正如一位语言学家所说，“你可以让其他人认为它是无稽之谈，但与此同时你却买它的账。”

rows.uncommon: n. （从事某行业的）行，商行（如拍卖行）
rows.en: …two biggest auction houses, Sotheby's and Christie's, had to pay out nearly $200m in guarantees to clients who had placed works for…
rows.cn: 几周之内，全球最大的两家拍卖行，苏富比和佳士得，不得不向那些将艺术品交由它们售卖的客户支付将近 2 亿美元的保证金。

rows.uncommon: v. 患上（疾病）；出现（症状）
rows.en: For example, heavier women are less likely to develop calcium deficiency than thin women.
rows.cn: 例如，与苗条的女性相比，较重的女性更不容易缺钙。

rows.en: Where is the line between ethical, persuasive design and dark patterns?
rows.cn: “合乎道德又有诱惑力的设计”和“黑暗模式”之间的界限在哪里？

rows.uncommon: n. （政府机构）局长，主任；公司董事
rows.en: Then they simply checked which directors stayed from one proxy statement to the next.
rows.cn: 然后他们只是核查了有哪些在同一公司连任的留任董事。

rows.en: I don't like quotas either; they run counter to my belief in meritocracy, governance by the capable.
rows.cn: 我也不喜欢定额；它们有悖于我所信仰的英才制度，即能者居之。

rows.en: "Glazing on windows, doors and roof lights must cover no more than 25% of the floor area to prevent heat loss," he says.
rows.cn: “门窗和天窗所用玻璃的面积将不得超过建筑面积的25%，以防止热量流失。”他说道。

rows.en: You cannot fire your family.
rows.cn: 你不可能解雇自己的家人。

rows.en: Some growth stems from a commitment by governments and farsighted businesses to fund cleaner energy sources.
rows.cn: 部分增长源于政府以及有远见的企业对更清洁能源承诺的资金支持。

rows.en: This normal human reaction is used to protect us by signaling danger and preparing us to deal with it.
rows.cn: 这一正常的人体反应通过发出危险信号让我们做好应对准备的方式来保护我们。

rows.en: …ericans continue to prize many of the same traditional milestones of a successful life, including getting married, having children,…
rows.cn: 跨越代际线，美国人依然高度重视许多相同的、传统的成功人生标志性事件，包括结婚、生子、购房及六十多岁退休。

rows.uncommon: a. 充满（某种情绪/氛围）的（-charged）
rows.en: But perhaps the most significant reason is that the issue has always been so politically charged.
rows.cn: 但是也许最重要的原因是，这个问题一直受到严重政治制约。

rows.en: And drivers hit these targets.
rows.cn: 司机们实现了这些目标。

rows.uncommon: a. 净的，纯的（net imports 净进口）
rows.en: … the second-largest net importer of timber in the world.
rows.cn: 目前，英国所需的木材中只有20%是本国生产的，同时英国仍然是世界第二大木材净进口国。

rows.en: …ims that people who lay fake grass spend an average of £500 on trees or shrubs for their garden, which provides habitat for insects.
rows.cn: 该行业还声称，铺设人造草坪的人平均会花费500英镑在花园的树木或灌木上，而这为昆虫提供了栖息之所。

rows.common: n. 盖子；帽子\nvt. 戴帽子
rows.en: The H-2A visa has no numerical cap, unlike the H-2B visa for nonagricultural work, which is limited to 66,000 a year.
rows.cn: 与非农工H-2B签证（每年上限为6.6万个）不同，H-2A签证没有数量限制。

rows.uncommon: a. （数量）固定不变的，无起伏的
rows.en: …mount that has been flat since 2001 (in inflation-adjusted dollars) with the exception of a onetime boost in 2009.
rows.cn: 国会每年仅向国家公园系统拨款30亿美元，这一数额自2001年以来一直持平（按通货膨胀调整后的美元计算），除2009年提振一次以外。

rows.uncommon: v. 激起，煽起（情绪、看法）
rows.en: Favoritism in official access can fan public perceptions of corruption.

rows.uncommon: n. 用途，好处（与熟义接近）
rows.en: The national parks provide great value to U.S. residents both as places to escape and as symbols of nature.
rows.cn: 国家公园作为隐逸的去处以及自然的象征，为美国居民提供了巨大价值。

rows.en: We need to adjust to this changing climate.
rows.cn: 我们需要适应这一变化的环境。

rows.en: Then there is the scale of the typical housing project.
rows.cn: 再有一个是典型住房项目的规模。

rows.common: n. 四轮大马车；教练\nvt. 训练
rows.uncommon: n./v. 教练（引申：指导，培训）
rows.en: One answer is fear, according to Jon Wortmann, an executive mental coach.
rows.cn: 高级心理培训师乔恩·沃特曼认为，答案之一是恐惧。

rows.en: Street festivals drive foot traffic to local businesses and foster the kind of cultural vibrancy that makes our city special.
rows.cn: 街头节庆为本地商家带来客流，并营造出让我们这座城市与众不同的文化活力。
